class UnionFind:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.parent = list(range(n))
        self.rank = [0]*n
    def find(self, x):
        while self.parent[x]!=x:
            self.parent[x]=self.parent[self.parent[x]]
            x=self.parent[x]
        return x
    def union(self, x, y):
        xr=self.find(x); yr=self.find(y)
        if xr==yr: return False
        if self.rank[xr]<self.rank[yr]:
            xr,yr=yr,xr
        self.parent[yr]=xr
        if self.rank[xr]==self.rank[yr]:
            self.rank[xr]+=1
        return True
